study_name: Unsaid Regional Banking Disclosure Removal Backtest (2019-2023)
description: 60 US banking institutions (crisis/delisted banks, regional banks, and megabank controls) evaluated across 5 fiscal years (2019-2023) to test if 10-K Item 1A and Item 7A disclosure removals predict forward excess returns over KRE.

universe_note: 57 unique institutions. Three duplicate ticker entries were removed: they collided on the {ticker}_{y1}_{y2} result key, so 60 entries could only ever produce 228 pairs, and the EWBC duplicate carried CIK 0001070412 which is CNX Resources Corp, a natural gas company. The correct entity won previously only because the sequential resume-skip passed over the second entry; a concurrent --freeze run would have raced.
